defect: The new BindFramebufferColor dereferences currentRenderVfb_->fbo without a null check, so the GE debugger's GetCurrentTexture -> SetTexture(true) path crashes when no render target is current.
reason: The unguarded dereference was added by this change and the GE debugger caller already existed at this commit; the fix adds exactly the missing currentRenderVfb_ check.

defect: The fix widens the UI's instancing check to GLES3 and GL 3.1, mirroring commit 37a0907 that widened the backend's GPU_SUPPORTS_INSTANCE_RENDERING detection.
reason: At this change the new UI check matched the backend's existing EXT_gpu_shader4-only detection exactly; the restriction predates the change and the fix is a follow-up to a feature extension.

defect: UnsyncKey now runs the escape/close-chat branch even when UIScreen::UnsyncKey already consumed the key, so typing a key bound as cancel (e.g. X) into the chat box closes the chat.
reason: Before the change a consumed key returned early; the change dropped that and the fix restores the !retval condition in a key() override.

defect: WARN_LOG passes the std::string logging_path to a %s format through varargs, which is undefined behaviour and rejected by clang.
reason: The log line was added by this change and logging_path is a std::string in MIPSTracer.h; the fix adds .c_str().

defect: The fix enables the MIPSTracer UI on non-Windows desktops, switches to System_BrowseForFile and rewires a Clear button added by a later commit.
reason: The parts touching this change's lines are platform enablement and a port of the file dialog; the miswired Clear button did not exist at this commit.

defect: The fix narrows sport to uint16_t, requires *len > 0, captures errno and deletes commented-out code.
reason: The real repair (32-bit write to the port pointer) comes from the previous commit 7f7b2a38; the fix only deletes this change's commented-out lines.

defect: The fix converts the debugger list-box code to wide strings (wsprintf, wchar_t) and _stricmp for a Unicode build.
reason: This change only refactored index loops into iterator loops; the ANSI string usage predates it and the fix is a Unicode port.

defect: The generated GLSL uses the float literal 1.0f, which is invalid in GLSL 1.10 / GLSL ES and makes the hardware-transform vertex shader fail to compile.
reason: The flipV line with 1.0f was added by this change and the fix changes it to 1.0.

defect: The fix clamps currentCount to maxCount, tracks numWaitThreads and renames the shadowing loop variable.
reason: This change only swapped __KernelResumeThread for __KernelResumeThreadFromWait, which the fix keeps; the count handling it repairs was already wrong.

defect: logicOpSupported is set from the compile-time USING_GLES2 macro, so a build without that macro running on a GLES context reports logic-op support it does not have.
reason: The #ifndef block was added by this change, and the surrounding code already uses the runtime gl_extensions.IsGLES; the fix replaces it with that runtime check.

defect: When hooking function exit, each jr ra found at address + offset is replaced by writing the hook at the function start (address) instead of at address + offset.
reason: The loop and the WriteReplaceInstruction(address, index) call were added by this change; the fix passes address + offset.

defect: The ARM64 AnyZeroSignBit(Vec4F32) passes the float32x4_t value.v to vmaxvq_s32 instead of the reinterpreted ival, a type error that strict compilers reject.
reason: The line was added by this change while ival was already computed above it; the fix uses ival.

defect: For arguments beyond the eighth, the stack address is computed from the uninitialized regval instead of reg, reading from a garbage address.
reason: The stack-read line was added by this change; the fix replaces regval - 8 with reg - 8.

defect: The fix adds an updateImmediately parameter to SetLabelName so renames refresh the active symbols.
reason: This change only reformatted the SetLabelName signature; the missing UpdateActiveSymbols call came from later activeLabels code.

defect: The fix adds a defaulted updateImmediately parameter to the SetLabelName declaration.
reason: The renaming bug arose when a later commit commented out UpdateActiveSymbols in SetLabelName; this change only declared the original interface.

defect: The fix passes false to SetLabelName in ApplyHashMap to skip a per-call UpdateActiveSymbols after SetLabelName's semantics changed.
reason: The call line comes from this change, but the fix adapts it to a later API change for performance, not a defect in this change.

defect: The fix loads ECX from rs before copying rt into rd, so the shift is right when rd == rs, and removes the DISABLE.
reason: The load-order bug existed before this change, which only disabled CompShiftVar; that bind line had been reverted to true before the fix.

defect: The fix clamps texture coordinates to the inner texel range (a half-texel inset in u_texclamp.zw) to stop bleeding from a larger framebuffer.
reason: The clamp to 0..u_texclamp existed before this change, which only extended it to projected coordinates; the edge bleeding is pre-existing.

defect: The 32-bit x86 path calls ABI_CallFunctionA with negSin2, which is not declared at that point, so the 32-bit build fails to compile.
reason: This change renamed negSin to negSin1 and introduced the negSin2 typo; the fix uses negSin1.

defect: The alias mapping uses opc > 8, so opcode 8 (sf) is not folded to 0 and is compiled as a VCMP with no matching case.
reason: The old switch handled case 8 together with case 0; this change's rewrite has an off-by-one comparison that the fix makes >= 8.

defect: WrapBeforeWord reads out_[out_.size() - 1] when out_ may be empty, an out-of-bounds access at the first word.
reason: The new file's function lacks the emptiness check that the fix adds.

defect: In the new SubmitPending, a Sync submit triggers readbackFence only when main commands are pending, so a Sync with only present commands submits no fence that the reader then waits on.
reason: The old code always used either fence or readbackFence; the conditional fence selection was added here and the fix triggers readbackFence for main or present commands.

defect: glInvalidateFramebuffer is called with count 3 on a 3-element array holding only two attachments, passing a zero (invalid) attachment enum.
reason: The call was added by this change; the fix uses a 2-element array and count 2.

defect: The fix always reads back as RGBA8888 and converts to the requested format, and frees the readback buffers on device destroy.
reason: The unsupported readback formats were a pre-existing gap (assert before, early return here); the fix implements the missing conversion.

defect: fwrite(&utfstring, length + 1, length + 3, f) writes the std::string object and reads far past it instead of writing the character data.
reason: The fwrite was added by this change; the fix writes utfstring.c_str() with the right size and count.

defect: In this file the fix only rewords the uneaten-prefix warning and adds js.LogPrefix(); the vmtvc repair is elsewhere.
reason: The touched lines are logging; no defect in this change is repaired here.

defect: The new min/max code writes rd = rs before comparing rs with rt, so when rd == rt the comparison uses the clobbered value and gives a wrong result (Disgaea fails).
reason: The enabled min/max were added by this change; the fix reorders them, disables them and names min/max as a broken-game cause.

defect: The new Show(type, text, text2, ...) overload forwards an empty string instead of text2, so the second text line is dropped.
reason: The forwarding overload was added by this change; the fix passes text2.

defect: The fix reads the file unencrypted when pgdInfo is null (and adds the same fallback to npdrmLseek) instead of returning 0 bytes.
reason: Reading npdrm-mode files without pgdInfo was already broken (a null dereference); this change only replaced the crash with a guard, and the fix supplies the real handling.

defect: The NEON path stores the uint32x4_t results of vdupq_n_u32, vandq_u32 and vld1q_u32 in int32x4_t variables, a type error that strict compilers reject.
reason: The NEON block was added by this change; the fix changes the types to uint32x4_t.

defect: The fix compares the memory word with MIPS_EMUHACK_OPCODE | block_num instead of the bare block number, so savestates under the JIT restore the original opcode.
reason: This change only added an (int) cast; the wrong comparison predates it.

defect: Choice::GetContentDimensionsBySpec with an image and text leaves out the 6px gap and does not subtract the image width from the text's available width, inconsistent with Draw.
reason: The combined image-plus-text measurement was added by this change; the fix adds the gap and subtracts totalW.

defect: The global PortManager destructor's fallback cleanup (Clear and Restore through miniupnpc) runs after WSACleanup at exit on Windows, so the UPnP calls fail and the mappings are not removed.
reason: The destructor and the constructor without a Winsock reference were added by this change; the fix adds net::Init and net::Shutdown around the object's lifetime.

defect: th is read with getTextureWidth instead of getTextureHeight, so the mip-height check is wrong.
reason: The line was added by this change; the fix corrects the copy-paste typo.

defect: The fix adds std::hex to the zero-padded branch so octets 10-15 are not written in decimal as 010..015.
reason: At this change the padded branch covered only 0-9, where decimal equals hex; the decimal output appeared when 486c32b widened it to 15, and the unpadded 10-15 octets predate this change.

defect: The fix adds write modes and test pipelines (stencil-only and depth-only writes, stencil-always plus depth) and renames variables.
reason: It extends the driver test to reproduce an Adreno bug; it repairs no defect in this change.

defect: The new member size_ of IRBlockCache is never initialized, so GetBlock before the first AllocateBlock compares against garbage and can return an invalid pointer.
reason: size_ was added by this change without initialization; the fix adds a constructor setting it to 0.

defect: The new UpdateUniforms early-outs without clearing dirtyUniforms and tests the lighting/material bits against the unmasked dirtyUniforms after dropping their -1 location guards, leaving stale bits and making redundant uniform uploads.
reason: Both inconsistencies came with this change's availableUniforms masking; the fix clears dirtyUniforms first and uses the masked dirty everywhere (the effect is minor, mainly wasted GL calls).

defect: The fix parenthesizes the ATRAC3+ frame-size expression to silence an operator-precedence warning.
reason: The formula was copied from the existing OMAConvert code; both forms agree when (code1 & 3) == 0, which holds for PSP ATRAC3+ frame sizes, so the fix is a warning cleanup.

defect: The fix parenthesizes the frame-size expression to silence an operator-precedence warning.
reason: convertStreamtoOMA returns early unless headerCode1 == 0x28, so (headerCode1 & 3) is 0 and both forms give the same value; no behaviour changes.
